title: Jennifer B NDE
content:
I was at a point where I realized my life was not in a good place. I was fed up and angry at myself for making un-beneficial choices. Driving to work one morning while feeling this intense anger, I said to myself, 'I'm not going to live this way anymore.' Disgust welled up inside of me and I burst into prayer. A passion came from deep within me, as words flew out of my mouth demanding change.

I prayed aloud, fiercely saying, 'God, you get down here, now, and fix my life or take me home. I have screwed it up, and I can't fix it. I'm done!' I didn't ask G-d to fix my life. I told him to fix it. Little did I know how quickly the divine would respond.

I arrived at work and routinely continued with my day. I had forgotten all about my morning hissy-fit prayer. Around lunchtime, I decided to go to the bank. Driving there, not three hours after my passionate prayer, a vision began to unfold like a movie in my mind's eye.

It all happened so fast. I saw a white car coming toward me and watched it hit my car head-on. I thought, 'What a strange vision!'

Just as the vision faded away, I looked ahead and actually saw a white car coming toward me. It crossed the yellow line. I knew it was going to hit me head-on. In a second's time, I recall thinking three things simultaneously, 'Oh, no! This isn't what I meant… Ah, sh*t, this is gonna hurt…and well, I guess my prayer's been answered.'

In that moment, I was positive Source Creator chose to take my life rather than fix it. Then, I panicked and thought, 'No, I can't leave my son behind!' My son was the only thing I wanted to live for. Yet, at the same time, I knew whatever was happening was sealed.

I was then drawn to look upward to my left. I saw a huge, brilliant light Being descending toward me at hyper-speed. I knew this being was Archangel Michael. Michael's energy force pulled me out of my body and car. Floating in a vortex of cloud-like, dark, silent space, I could only see a trail of light emanating from Michael's path ahead of me. I was magnetically connected to it. I gently glided upward behind Michael, having no movement or control of my own. I then heard the cars crash behind me. I instantly realized Michael had taken me out of my body long before the crash even took place. I knew the body I left behind felt the impact of the hit, but I felt nothing but perfection.

When I began to turn my head to look at the crash scene, Michael halted me and kept my gaze on him instead. I felt I didn't need to see the crash. At that moment, I realized I was no longer alive on Earth. I felt a heaviness move through me when I realized I had left my son behind. I thought, 'No, I can't die. I can't leave him.' Michael then reminded me of the day my son had been electrocuted and that he is always watched over. Understanding that Michael was one of the three angels that had visited my son, I thought, 'Okay, then. I'm ready to go.'

I looked forward into Michael's trail of light with awe and was bathed in the illumination. As we went higher, a whitish haze began to appear all around me. It was so silent, peaceful, pure, and complete. There was no emotion, thought, or separation. Telepathic knowing took the place of spoken language. I was unified with everything, everywhere, and completely immersed in love.

As I gazed at Michael ahead of me. The light trail began to expand and I merged deeper into it. Then I began to hear a faint, angelic, divine sound. It wasn't music. Yet, it was the most magical symphony of immaculate sound. I remembered knowing that sound. Then, the white haze became thicker, and we picked up speed. As we began to lean toward the right, I saw a piercing, brilliant, white light beginning to engulf everything. The bright light exploded as we entered it.

I was then standing inside a white space in front of an entryway. Archangel Michael was to my left and Archangel Gabriel was to my right. Neither, by the way, were human-like; nor were they Male or Female. They were illuminated beings that were both, masculine and feminine. I knew them well, and they knew me perfectly. I sensed this was not the first time we had been together. Michael and Gabriel knew everything about my being, as evidenced when we then exchanged telepathic conversation.

While I don't recall what the angels said to me, I do recall what I said to them. They must have told me I would be going back to Earth because I remember adamantly disagreeing stating, 'You can’t do that! You can’t bring people here and then send them back to that! It’s just not right!'

They both spoke to me. Whatever they said led me to look ahead, into the entryway. The entry was dark. As I slightly recalled humans being afraid of the dark, I thought, 'Um, that's pretty dark in there.' I asked if they were going to send me into that darkness.

I curiously peered into the void of nothingness. I began to feel the space itself morphing into ‘something’. It sounded and moved like gentle water as it approached. Then the waves began to shape into an illuminated, fluid-Being.

As the Being approached the entryway where I stood, I, and everything else became silent, glowing, and awe-filled. I knew this Being was All perfection, Creator, God, the Holy Spirit, The Father, Source of ALL things ever Created, and it held the existence of ALL beings and things within its existence.

I then understood why the entryway looked dark. The light inside was so bright and blinding, it appeared black. It is just like when we look at the sun and everything turns black afterward. My human-defined perception of darkness was erased for me.

I recalled I had been with Creator before, and knew of its ever-changing omnipresence, and how Creator manifests its existence in endless ways. At that point, I was directed to refer to this Being appropriately; The 'Nameless Source' and not the name 'God.' I understood why… the word, and entity 'God' was manufactured by humankind. This concept manifests separateness from Creator, Source of All.' This isn't so.

I was overcome with indescribable awe, opened my arms wide, kneeled, and bowed before Creator, in pure unadulterated honor. Source sent through me, what I can only describe as a loving smile, and spoke, 'Nay. Stand, stand. All are equal.' Simultaneously, Source lifted me up into an upright standing position, directly facing its presence. I say, ‘It’ instead of he or she, because I knew referring to Source as a human, Male, Female, or a name, degrades and adulterates Creator’s awe and divine perfection.

My communication with Source, Michael, and Gabreil was what we define as telepathic, but that doesn’t even describe the all-encompassing knowing to the fullest. While communication with Michael and Gabriel felt more physical, the communication with Creator was a more easily accessible ‘divine language.’ My whole being was one with Creator's language and my Soul knew and understood everything.

I recalled Creator, this indescribably magnificent Being, had dealt with me before at this very entryway; yet in a different way. I knew everything and also nothing at the same time. I, of course, was no longer feisty. Now, I expressed my desire to stay in the afterlife, in sacred awe, as love, to which there are no words or definitions to describe.

Upon my request to stay with them, Source’s fluid presence began to move closer toward me. As it did, slow motion took hold. I began to sense a water's wave of a spinning-motion encircle me. There was a deafening silence; yet, I could hear the heavenly music. The music was echoing everywhere, and within me. Source then spoke through me and filled me up with the mystery of wisdom. Source stretched out what could only be described in human terms as illuminated arms. In a timeless moment of being bathed in love, I thought, 'Oh, good, Creator is going to hug me and let me stay.'

I watched in awe, as Creator’s illuminated waters, reached toward my chest. Then, a brilliant, blinding flash of light exploded. I was flung backward, stretching out my arms, saying, 'No!'

I was enveloped in a white, hazy cloud. At first, I thought Creator sent me to another place in the afterlife because I still felt like I was a Spirit body. I then realized I was sitting inside my vehicle, and the white haze was simply the contents of my car's airbag.

Still not believing Source sent me back, I began to question whether I was alive or dead. I felt like I was dead; or at least, a Spirit, still floating in heaven. I thought maybe Creator sent me back as a spirit guide and I was invisibly hovering in the car. I could still feel Archangel Michael nearby helping me ground and understand, so I just waited. Then, when a friend stopped to help me get out of my car, I knew I was back in the body. I sat there for a few moments just shaking my head. I was completely stunned that they had sent me back. But, I felt so perfect and couldn't give thought to anything less than that.

Michael then sent his wisdom through me confirming that we, four, were synchronized. I knew right then that nothing would ever be the same. Of course, it didn’t stop there. I was compelled to experience many things out to the norm, and follow the guidance of the invisible world. As the days and years progressed, I felt the emergence of my soul-self and the sacred relationship with the infinite divine presence.

As time passed, I began to recognize an endless trail of mysterious changes to my intelligence, extra-sensory abilities, overall personality. Everything I was and did prior, changed. I was held in the grips of spirit transforming everything about me and my life. I easily received this because I felt like a pure, innocent, 5 year-old child seeing life with untainted eyes. I had not a care in the world. I saw nothing as wrong, broken, or damaged and everything had a divine-lining. Comically, this state earned me the nickname 'Glossy'. I had a knack for understanding the divine language in everything.

I have spent the past 19 years communicating divine linguistics, prophetic messages, and understandings of the origins beyond which compelled me to write 9 books on self empowerment, self-help, and spiritual ascension. Having the near death, out-of-body, and other worldly experiences continue, I was led to write my book, "Life Beyond Us." I am currently starting a second, with more experiences, and my most recent 3 NDE's - that's how much awe, love and magic Spirit wants us to receive! haha

Creator did take me home AND fix my life.

Not only am I beyond grateful my sassy prayer was answered, I enjoy the loving reminder of my precious, divine reunion with Creator, Michael, and Gabreil everyday by a scar imprinted on my forearm. It is in the shape of Archangel Michael, flying upward, bringing me into the light, exactly as I experienced.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Other Unsure as I was not in body I was in a head on car accident.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was out of the body traveling in archangel Michael's light trail before the car is crashed as I heard the cars crash afterward. I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal I knew everything telepathically, instantly, and what everything meant without explanation or thought.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual Much slower
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Earthly visions were slow and formed, like having edges. The afterlife was opposite, all flowing and no limiting structure
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I could hear everything everywhere, not just in my occupied space. Hearing was also not structured. It was more like an echo.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I travelled behind Archangel Michael in his light trail and then was taken into the tremendous light
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The Heaven I entered was the dividing point between light and dark. The entryway to the origin, before visible creations, the void before light was manifested.
elements.What other emotions did you feel during: My emotional state was in Awe, amazement, love, peace, and all-encompassing perfection until I realized I left my son behind. Then I felt panic and heartache for a split second until Michael reassured me.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Specifically, Everything about heaven, creation, space and before incarnation.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future I saw the accident unfold before impact
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I told Michael and Gabreil it was not fair to bring us here and not let us stay. I thought I would be allowed to stay but Creator proved me wrong.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Other Christian I held various religious beliefs but did not practice or attend church
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I do not claim religion but teach it benefits and also it demise.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths I do not claim a religion. I understand all faiths and religions have been 'edited' by humankind and overall, texts are applicable as a divine symbolic language and guidance tool through ascension and rebirth processes in life.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I never believed I would experience or see angels or Creator god - nor did I believe I was good enough to stand before them.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes All values and beliefs were burned away and regarding installed with divine teachings and knowledge.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Archangel Michael, Gabreil, and Creator all spoke energetically/telepathically.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Creator, within its shapeshifting waters held (or consisted of) all divine beings of service. I did not see their presence but knew Creator is ALL things and ALL things are an extension from it.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I knew in order fro Michael to have come and 'retrieved' me there was definitely a union with the angels and they knew what was happening to me (us) before an event even happens
Yes Can't deny after existence when an Archangel comes in and snatches you into the universe.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes Everything is pre destined and exquisitely planned before entering the human body. Spirit and beyond know ALL things and are always tending to all things happening everywhere. All things and experiences take place, not against people, but to keep balance within all creations.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I told the three 'You can't bring us here and then send us back to earth, it's just not fair.' Implying Earth was challenging
Yes I felt their love but the love of creator was beyond words.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life Too many changes that I had to write it all into books. As for the self, everything changed except my spicy attitude. Hahah but it has been toned down.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: I'm nicer and more patient with people (most o the time) I intuit everything so I know beforehand what and who align with my essence. Yes
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience The NDE is crystal clear. Everything else fades.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes At some point I access all psychic abilities when needed but the main abilities are understanding divine language, all Clair abilities, Seer, and Spirit messenger.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I thought only certain 'chosen' people had NDE's
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably not real I pondered whether or not my brain made it up or maybe I dreamed it. Then, I knew it was real when I began receiving other-worldly messages and seeing events happen.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Everything I experienced thereafter, proved it was real... and I haven't stopped experiencing it in 19 years.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain I don't understand what the question is asking - reproduced. If it means additional NDs and out of body experiences Yes.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Ask and you are sure to receive - Or - Be careful what you ask for - Being Spiritually charged isn't for sissies!
